release_contents: Recruitment application form field requirements: per-posting Required/Optional configuration for profile photo, CV, weekly availability, experience, contribution, skills, district, current location, profession and preferred contact (JobPosting::CONFIGURABLE_APPLICATION_FIELDS / resolvedFieldRequirements(), new nullable JSON column job_postings.field_requirements). Identity/contact fields and consent declarations stay permanently required. Admin gets an 'আবেদন ফরমের ফিল্ড সেটিংস' card on the posting form; the public API exposes field_requirements; VolunteerApplicationController::rules() is generated from it. Application PDF export (mpdf/mpdf, chosen over dompdf after empirically verifying real Bengali conjunct shaping — see app/Services/RecruitmentPdfService.php's docblock) and a browser print view, both admin.recruitment.applications.{pdf,print} routes (permission:recruitment.view), sharing one document.blade.php partial that excludes internal_note/interview_*/reviewed_by/status/ids/storage paths. Admin detail page reorganized into grouped sections with real photo preview/download and a CV empty-state. Custom branded error pages: Laravel resources/views/errors/{403,404,419,429,500,503} and Next.js (site)/{not-found,error}.tsx + root not-found.tsx/global-error.tsx. Icon subset regenerated 82->85 glyphs. 32 new tests (427 total), full suite green including inside the isolated build-tree run.

server_side_composer_note: build step installed mpdf/mpdf v8.3.1 + deps (setasign/fpdi, mpdf/psr-log-aware-trait, mpdf/psr-http-message-shim) cleanly on production, exit 0. check_platform_reqs confirmed ext-gd and ext-zlib both present (both required by mPDF) — first real confirmation of ext-zlib specifically on this host.
pdf_font_note: Noto Sans Bengali (Regular+Bold) vendored at admin-erp/resources/fonts/*.ttf, inside private.tar (not the public docroot). RecruitmentPdfService registers them via mPDF's fontdata config with autoScriptToLang/autoLangToFont explicitly OFF — mPDF's own script auto-detection was found to silently fall back to a non-Bengali core font for BOLD text specifically once a custom font is registered, producing tofu boxes; turning it off and relying solely on the explicit font registration fixed this for every weight. Do not re-enable those two options without re-verifying bold Bengali rendering.
